augmentation: extra context views by the base rule (uniform_0_4); nothing else
base_basis: PLAN_BEFORE_V11_RESULTS.md (sha256 b726d336a6b6377f49d75c991e228a21380092312d6ee5e9b6f57828f639fb1c), written before any V11 result: V12 runs only if the V11 EVAL-V3 COMPLETION_GAIN point estimate is >0; COMPLETION_GAIN=0.005230385700675394
checkpoint_selection: independent per variant/seed using the frozen V2 DEV rule; never best seed
context_input: context RGB + measured context ray distance + cameras (RGB-D track); query depth never enters construction
context_roles: independent A/B states, equal loss weights
dev_reuse: the 8 DEV scenes were evaluated in V2-V11 and Core B V1/V2; in V12 DEV only selects checkpoints and gives descriptive results; the primary cohort is EVAL-V4; FRESH-V1, FRESH-V2 and EVAL-V3 are not used

control.method: V11 C1 selected checkpoints, V11 loader, never retrained

eval_v4.role: primary mechanism cohort: never read before its preparation, scene- and asset-disjoint from every used scene and from EVAL-V3, volume-disjoint from DEV and FRESH, may share volumes with TRAIN72 and EVAL-V3; never a qualification cohort

execution: all six runs (2 widths x 3 seeds) concurrently, one core each, on CPU cores 8-23, possibly alongside V10 (its directories are excluded from the seal); no GPU is used or queried (GPU paused by the user); min_free_gpu_mib is unused
infrastructure_failure_policy: a signal-terminated run, or a run whose log shows a fixed CUDA resource-allocation signature, is moved to audit/failed_attempts with an incident record and rerun from scratch with identical variant/seed/config, at most infrastructure_retries times per run counted across runner invocations; archived checkpoints and DEV curves are never used; any other Python error is never retried; a failed C0/C1 run stops the experiment
initialize: from scratch; torch.manual_seed(seed) then the width's carrier; C0 equals the V11 C1 draw; the depth bypass starts at zero without consuming the RNG
primary_contrast: EVAL-V4 WIDTH64_COMPLETION_GAIN = FAR AbsRel(V11 C1 selected, the plan's control) - FAR AbsRel(C1 width 64); secondary HARMONIC_HYBRID_GAIN = AbsRel(REPROJ_HARMONIC) - AbsRel(HFILL8 of C1) and HFILL8_WIDTH_GAIN = AbsRel(HFILL8 of V11 C1) - AbsRel(HFILL8 of C1)
sampling: seeded scene permutation cycled; primary query slot cycles per scene visit; uniform with-replacement rays, identical indices for A/B and all variants; the extra-view count comes from its own generator so the ray stream is unchanged
secondary_contrast: DEV WIDTH_GAIN_DEV = AbsRel(C0) - AbsRel(C1), frozen V2 estimator, descriptive
seed_handling: all seeds equally weighted within scene; each seed reported
statistics: frozen V2 estimator (geometry_carrier_statistics); its SURFACE_* fields denote the secondary DEV C0-C1 contrast, i.e. WIDTH_GAIN_DEV in V12
train_targets: TRAIN primary_query2 RGB+ray-distance depth; never carrier input
